description: Binary search for the commit that introduced a bug. Returns structured data with action taken, current commit, remaining steps estimate, and result.

bad.description: Bad commit ref (used with start action)

command.description: Script/command to run for automated bisection (used with run action). Must return exit code 0 for good, 1-124/126-127 for bad, 125 to skip. Security: the executable is validated against the ALLOWED_COMMANDS policy when configured.

firstParent.description: Follow only first parent on merge commits (--first-parent)

good.description: Good commit ref(s) — single string or array of refs to narrow the search range (used with start action)

noCheckout.description: Perform bisection without checking out each commit (--no-checkout)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

paths.description: Restrict bisection to changes affecting specific paths (-- <paths>)

replayFile.description: Path to bisect log file used by replay action

termNew.description: Custom term for the new/bad state (--term-new)

termOld.description: Custom term for the old/good state (--term-old)

name: bisect
title: Git Bisect
